newsitem.title: UK: Trocadero to build All Star Cafe in London.
newsitem.headline: Trocadero to build All Star Cafe in London.

text.p: British leisure group Trocadero Plc said on Monday it received planning approval to build an "Official All Star Cafe" theme restaurant in London's Piccadilly Circus.
Trocadero said Westminster City Council granted planning consent for the 20,000 square foot restaurant within the company's Pepsi Trocadero complex.
The restaurant, part of a joint venture with Planet Hollywood, was backed by a number of sport celebrities, including Tiger Woods and Andre Agassi, Trocadero said in a statement.
